title: The Age of Dinosaurs, Beginning to End
description: Tonight, the entire age of the dinosaurs, from the beginning of it to the end of it, in order, without hurrying. About a hundred and sixty-five million years, at a pace meant for falling asleep.

There is an asteroid in this story and you already know about it. It arrives near the end, it gets a short chapter — shorter than the chapter about ferns — and it is not the ending. The ending is the chapter after it, and that one is about birds.
No jeopardy, no countdown, nothing waiting in the dark. Everything here finished a very long time ago, and most of it did not finish at all.

accuracy: Every factual claim in The Age of Dinosaurs, Beginning to End traces to one of these. Where researchers disagree — and in this episode they disagree about a great deal, including when flowers appeared and what colour any of these animals were — the episode says so, and both sides are listed here rather than only the tidier one.
